requirements_addressed: StepStatus StrEnum with closed value set (pending/running/passed/failed/awaiting_approval)

completion_promises.criterion_text: forge.persistence.repositories.runbook_models exists and exports StepStatus, StepResult, Step, Runbook, RunbookValidationError
completion_promises.evidence: Created src/forge/persistence/repositories/runbook_models.py with all required exports. Updated __init__.py to re-export all five names. Verified with import test and pytest TestImports class.

completion_promises.criterion_text: StepStatus has exactly the five members pending/running/passed/failed/awaiting_approval and nothing else; a test asserts the membership set is closed
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented StepStatus as StrEnum with exactly five members. TestStepStatusEnum.test_step_status_has_five_members asserts the closed set using set comparison.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Constructing a Runbook with an empty steps tuple raises RunbookValidationError (ASSUM-002)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented __post_init__ validation in Runbook that checks if steps is empty and raises RunbookValidationError with message referencing ASSUM-002. TestRunbookValidation.test_empty_steps_raises_validation_error verifies this behavior.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Constructing a Runbook with current_step_index outside [0, len(steps)-1] raises RunbookValidationError (ASSUM-004)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented __post_init__ validation in Runbook that checks current_step_index is in valid range [0, len(steps)-1] and raises RunbookValidationError with message referencing ASSUM-004. Two tests verify negative and beyond-range cases.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Constructing a Step with an empty step_type raises RunbookValidationError (ASSUM-005)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented __post_init__ validation in Step that checks step_type is non-empty (after stripping whitespace) and raises RunbookValidationError with message referencing ASSUM-005. TestStepValidation.test_empty_step_type_raises_validation_error verifies this.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A freshly constructed three-step Runbook with current_step_index=0 and every step StepStatus.pending is valid and equality-comparable (frozen dataclass equality)
completion_promises.evidence: Created frozen dataclasses with @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True). TestRunbookConstruction.test_three_step_runbook_is_valid_and_comparable constructs a three-step runbook and verifies equality comparison works correctly.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Step.result defaults to None; a StepResult round-trips its exit_code, captured_output, started_at, completed_at via dataclass equality
completion_promises.evidence: Step.result field has default value None. StepResult is a frozen dataclass with all four required fields. TestStepResultRoundTrip has three tests verifying: default None, setting a result, and round-trip equality of all fields.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Models are immutable: attempting to set an attribute on a Runbook or Step raises (frozen=True)
completion_promises.evidence: All three dataclasses (Runbook, Step, StepResult) use @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True). TestImmutability has three tests that verify attempting to set attributes raises AttributeError for each model type.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit tests live in tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_models.py and are written test-first (TDD)
completion_promises.evidence: Created tests/forge/persistence/test_runbook_models.py with 14 tests covering all acceptance criteria. Followed TDD RED-GREEN cycle: wrote tests first (RED phase - tests failed due to missing module), then implemented code (GREEN phase - all tests pass).
